title: Chapter 3 — Big Boys
description: Chief Ọ̀dụ̀ wants an assistant. The fake parts come back with a driver. Ike can't laugh any more, and he knows why.

beats.speaker: ike
beats.text: Boy! Sweep the front. Customers judge a shop by its floor.

variants.text: Partner! (He has started calling you partner since the fee. He says it like a joke he doesn't find funny.)

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Three months of sleeping on cartons. The rats have stopped running when you come in. They consider you staff.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A black car stops outside the shop. Chief Ọ̀dụ̀'s driver gets out and asks for you by name.

beats.speaker: usher
beats.text: The Chief needs an assistant. He asked for 'the hungry one'.

variants.text: The Chief wants to see the boy who notices things. He doesn't usually want to see those.
The Chief needs someone quiet. He says you are quiet. He means it as a compliment.

beats.speaker: player
beats.text: (Ike is watching you from behind a pile of tyres.)

options.text: Go and work for Chief Ọ̀dụ̀.
Stay with Ike. He brought you to Lagos.
Open your own small stall. Honest parts.

beats.speaker: passenger
beats.text: YOU! You sold me 'original' brake pads! They failed on the bridge! My children were in the car!

beats.speaker: player
beats.text: (The driver is sitting on the kerb, breathing hard. His children are fine. He isn't.)

options.text: Pay for his repairs. All of them.

beats.speaker: usher
beats.text: The box you lost belonged to the Fellowship. The Fellowship does not lose things. It collects them. You owe us.

beats.speaker: usher
beats.text: The box arrived. The Fellowship notices reliable hands.

beats.speaker: ike
beats.text: Commander Bassey asked about you. Your face is in his little book. Keep it out of trouble.

beats.speaker: uncleDozie
beats.text: (a voice note from the village) The buyer came back. Your mother refused to sign. Your mother has more liver than you. I hope you are proud.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Night. Ike buys two bottles and sits with you on the kerb at the Back Side. He tells a joke about a goat and a customs officer. You laugh until you cry.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Ike doesn't laugh. He watches you laughing like a man watching a film of a country he used to live in.

beats.speaker: ike
beats.text: Everything has a price, Emeka. I paid mine. Since that night... I can't laugh. Even when it's funny. Especially when it's funny.

beats.speaker: ike
beats.text: (He's drunk enough to tell you the truth. Not drunk enough to forget he told it.)

options.text: "What night, Ike? What did you pay?"
"So? You have a Benz. Who needs to laugh?"

beats.speaker: ike
beats.text: The Fellowship of Endless Abundance. You put your name in the white book, they put money in your hand. And they take something you didn't know you had.

beats.speaker: ike
beats.text: (He looks at you for a long time.) Leave them? You don't leave them, Emeka. They leave you. Empty.

cards.title: The Chief's house
cards.text: You carry files. You fetch cars. You learn which senator likes which wine. One night the Chief leaves his study open. On the desk: a white book with a red ribbon.

beats.speaker: player
beats.text: (Nobody is in the corridor.)

options.text: Take photos of every page with your phone.
Leave it. Some books read you back.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Names. Hundreds. Senators, pastors, a footballer you love. Ike Okafor, written two years ago. And on the last page, in fresh red ink: your name. Already written. Waiting.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Your own corner of the market. Honest parts, honest prices, honest losses. Your customers come back. Some of them even pay.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Ike works you hard and pays you less. But some nights he leaves food by your mat without saying anything.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The next morning there's an envelope on your mat. White. Heavy. Your name in gold.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: "The Fellowship of Endless Abundance invites you to its Night of Increase. White attire. Come alone. Come hungry."

variants.text: "The Fellowship of Endless Abundance invites our Chief's assistant to its Night of Increase. White attire. Come alone. Come hungry."
"The Fellowship of Endless Abundance invites you to settle your account at its Night of Increase. White attire. Come alone."

beats.title: End of Chapter 3 — Big Boys
beats.summary: The white envelope is on your mat. Money {money}. Conscience {stat:conscience}. The Fellowship's hold {stat:hold}.
